body.description: Pixel-art diorama: an intimate lived-in refuge at a dungeon entrance. Broad connected color clusters, compact heroic silhouettes, matte planes, crisp stepped edges, quiet shadow masses and selective details. 8-12 varied mercenaries talk in pairs, share bowls and mend equipment, amid bedrolls, patched cloth and sacks. Exactly ONE small mage stands apart, STRICTLY BACK TO CAMERA, entirely in deep architectural shadow. Opaque black hood and cloak conceal face, skin, hands, hair, age and gender; no rim light. Nobody notices, looks toward or reacts to the mage. Social warmth belongs to others; the mage is excluded from their connections. No war, army, battlefield, ruined city, monsters, epic scale, magic glow, grain, dithering, text, icons or HUD. PLACE: A low decommissioned cistern has dry raised walkways between narrow water channels. Two squat ribs of masonry form distinct domestic pockets. A black inspection passage is the dungeon threshold. COMPOSITION: Long horizontal section through squat vaults; repeating ribs interrupted by one diagonal wooden shelf. COLOR SCRIPT: deep plum shadows, dusty terracotta stone, parchment fabric, restrained copper lights. Restrained saturation, a legible dark mage silhouette. One complete scene with a quiet dark surrounding field, no decorative frame.
